/* Спільні стилі: add_discount.html, create_product.html, edit_product.html, order_detail.html, orders.html, vendor.html */ .vendor-sidebar-title { font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; color: var(--gray-2); text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.5px; padding: 0 20px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--gray-4); margin-bottom: 8px; } .vendor-nav { list-style: none; } .vendor-nav li a:hover, .vendor-nav li a.active { background: var(--green-light); color: var(--green); border-left-color: var(--green); } .vendor-nav svg { width: 20px; height: 20px; color: currentColor; }
